criterion: per file, the odf reader of the file kind (odt, ods, odp) reads it; ok when it returns or throws an error of the package's own hierarchy (OdfError) within the budget; a failure is an untyped throw, a hang, memory past the cap or a crash of the child
budget: 10 s per case for an input up to 10 MB, plus 1 s per further MB (hard cap twice the budget); 1 GiB peak memory
